title: spec-review finding
description: One adversarial-review finding against a spec/proposal document. Emitted as one JSON object per line in <lens>.findings.jsonl during Phase 2; validator_verdict is populated by the orchestrator after Phase 3.

id.description: Stable per-run finding ID, e.g. 'logic-auditor-003'. Prefix with the lens name, zero-padded index suffix.

severity.description: blocking = must be resolved before this proceeds; major/minor/nit = severity-ranked per the report's Major/Minor/Nit section. A finding that is reviewer taste rather than a defect must be 'nit', not a higher tier.

confidence.description: How directly the evidence proves the claim — high = the anchor alone proves it; medium = anchor + one inference step; low = inferred from indirect signals.

heading.description: The document heading (or 'preamble' if before the first heading) the quote is drawn from.

quote.description: Exact quoted phrase from the document. A finding with no anchor is not a finding — do not emit one with an empty or paraphrased quote.

refs.description: Phase 1 inventory IDs this finding relates to: C=Claims, A=Assumptions, D=Decisions, R=Requirements, SC=Success criteria, SB=Scope boundaries, DEP=Dependencies.

consequence.description: The concrete, specific consequence if unaddressed — not 'this is unclear' but the actual downstream failure this causes.

suggested_fix.description: A specific suggested fix, or the specific question the author needs to answer.

validator_verdict.description: Populated by the orchestrator after Phase 3 adversarial validation. Absent on the specialist's initial emission.

reasoning.description: The validator's reasoning, kept for the 'Considered and dropped' appendix when refuted.

votes.description: Number of validators that voted 'survived', out of votes_total. Only present at --depth deep (3-validator majority).
